name: Probe Kit
description: The smallest kit that exercises real flow mechanics: context injection at a plan gate, evidence gathering at a verify gate, and a terminal step. It exists to be MEASURED, not to do useful work — a full builder.build run takes tens of minutes and cannot be a unit of experimental iteration. This runs in seconds against a scripted agent, so the harness that measures kits can itself be proven end to end, and so a change to a flow definition can be A/B'd against its predecessor in the time it takes to read the diff.

flows.description: plan -> implement -> verify, with a gate on the plan and a gate on the evidence.
